faqs.q: How long does general construction take in the Central Pacific?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope: a home or commercial unit usually takes 3 to 8 months, and an industrial warehouse 4 to 12 months. We deliver a detailed schedule before starting and follow it with ongoing supervision.

faqs.q: Do you handle building permits in Costa Rica?
faqs.a: Yes. We manage the paperwork with the Municipality of Garabito, ICE and other agencies, so your project has all the required permits and inspections in order without you having to wait in lines.

faqs.q: What warranty do construction projects include?
faqs.a: All our work includes structural and finish warranties: from 3 months for repairs up to 24 months for major works. We work with certified materials and an up-to-date corporate registration.
